title: Effect Evaluation Result v1
description: Host-controlled evaluation decision evidence for model-originated Effect Proposals. This object records inspection evidence and confers zero execution permission, authorization, or capability admission.

schema_version.description: Semantic type identity. Distinct from proposal and capability schemas.

proposal_reference.description: Cryptographic reference or identifier binding this evaluation evidence to a specific EFFECT_PROPOSAL-v1 instance.

evaluation_context_reference.description: Reference binding the evaluation decision to the exact host state and policy context used during inspection.

decision.description: The terminal host-controlled outcome of the evaluation process.

decision_reason_class.description: Categorized governance classification of the decision outcome.

evaluation_basis.description: List of policy rules, context constraints, or check identifiers evaluated by the host.

capability_candidate_reference.description: Optional reference to a host-compiled CapabilityPayloadV1 candidate. Must be null unless decision is accepted.
